races.name: Track Radio On Digital & DAB Apprentice Handicap

runners_data.name: Look Back Smiling
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with 61 days off but soft ground suits, new stable debut adds intrigue despite poor recent form
runners_data.comment: After changing hands for 9,000gns he was out the back on stable debut at Bath
runners_data.spotlight: Lost his way last autumn and, after changing hands for 9,000gns, he was out the back on stable debut at Bath (1m, good; fine on soft); potentially well handicapped but has enough to prove.

runners_data.name: Platinum Prince
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who won this race last year off 3lb lower mark, prefers softer ground than recent comeback effort
runners_data.comment: Seven career wins include this race 12 months ago off only 3lb lower
runners_data.spotlight: Needs a revival but fast ground wasn't ideal on his comeback run and seven career wins include this race 12 months ago off only 3lb lower; rarely looks straightforward but remains capable of winning races.

runners_data.name: Bizou
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in great form with two recent wins, only 2lb higher than last success and suits this tactical scenario
runners_data.comment: Improving hat-trick seeker but slow ground hasn't looked ideal previously
runners_data.spotlight: Improved to win at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) and followed up from the front at Wolverhampton (9.4f), albeit by the skin of her teeth; only 2lb higher so remains on a competitive mark, but slow ground hasn't looked ideal previously.

runners_data.name: Perfect Scoundrel
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who has been well beaten in recent handicaps and only dropped 5lb, hard to fancy
runners_data.comment: Beaten between 6.5l and 11l in his three handicaps (1m2f-1m4f) and has only dropped 5lb
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten between 6.5l and 11l in his three handicaps (1m2f-1m4f) and has only dropped 5lb; doesn't look a winner waiting to happen.

runners_data.name: Oman
runners_data.note: Versatile hold-up runner who ran well last time at Lingfield, entitled to be competitive despite being hard to call well-handicapped
runners_data.comment: Versatile ground-wise and he wasn't far off the principals last time at Lingfield
runners_data.spotlight: Versatile ground-wise and he wasn't far off the principals last time at Lingfield (1m2f); hard to call him well handicapped but entitled to have some say.

runners_data.name: Tilani
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with two wins from four starts for current connections, both victories came on good ground over 1m
runners_data.comment: Had no penalty last time and now 6lb higher, but he's on a roll; has won on soft
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish gelding who has only had four runs for Ian Williams and won the last two, 1m handicaps on good ground at Newbury and Yarmouth; had no penalty last time and now 6lb higher, but he's on a roll; has won on soft.

runners_data.name: Pay Attention
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse wearing first-time headgear combination, better off at weights with Tilani after recent Newbury effort
runners_data.comment: Chance on his Newbury run last time but softening ground might not be favourable
runners_data.spotlight: Missed the break at Newbury (1m, good; in this first-time headgear combination) but still got to challenge Tilani and he's better off at the weights with that rival here; has missed three engagements in the last year on account of good to soft and soft ground.

runners_data.name: Somkiyr
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front runner in the field, modest recent form but will likely dictate the pace without early pressure
runners_data.comment: Modest hurdler and hasn't been finding life all that easier back on the Flat
runners_data.spotlight: Won in France at two; modest hurdler for current team and hasn't been finding life all that easier back on the Flat.

runners_data.name: Trooper
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 405-day absence after disappointing hurdling career, current wellbeing highly questionable
runners_data.comment: Current wellbeing is an issue but goes well with ease underfoot and cheekpieces go on
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time Flat winner in Belgium/Germany and could be glad to see the back of hurdles having offered nothing in that scene; current wellbeing is an issue but goes well with ease underfoot and cheekpieces go on; he'd be interesting if market vibes did bode well.

races.paceDynamic: Somkiyr appears the only natural front runner willing to take this on from the gates, with Bizou and Tilani the most likely prominent racers to track him early. The modest pace pressure should allow Somkiyr to dictate comfortable fractions through the first half-mile, creating a race where the tempo builds gradually rather than being honest throughout. With six of nine runners showing hold-up tendencies, there will be significant traffic problems in the straight as the bulk of the field comes from off the pace simultaneously. This race shape strongly favours the prominent racers and early pace-setters who can avoid the late scramble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Running Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Somkiyr or Bizou can dictate comfortable fractions without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The pace-setter gets first run in the straight while hold-up horses get caught in traffic, allowing the early leader to hold on despite the weight of numbers coming from behind. Prominent racers avoid the late bottleneck that typically develops when seven horses try to make their moves simultaneously.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Late Kick
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely steady and the hold-up horses get clear racing room
scenarios.body: The patient tactics pay off as horses like Platinum Prince and Look Back Smiling can unleash superior finishing kicks from clean positions. The prominent racers tie up having done too much early work against each other.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Tilani and Bizou engage in early tactical speed battles with Somkiyr
scenarios.body: The increased tempo sets up a more genuine test where stamina becomes crucial over the extended 1m1f trip. Hold-up horses benefit from the stronger gallop but still need luck in running to deliver their challenges.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the field bunches up turning for home with multiple horses needing racing room
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure lottery where positioning and jockey skill matter more than actual ability. Any horse getting a clear run can capitalize while better fancied rivals are stopped in their tracks.

watchPoints.text: Trooper has been absent for over 13 months since moving from European flat racing to British hurdles - fitness and wellbeing are major concerns
Pay Attention missed the break badly at Newbury despite wearing headgear for the first time - watch for any market confidence or gate alertness
Somkiyr will likely face no early pressure as the sole front runner - monitor if he can sustain a gallop when challenged
Look Back Smiling makes stable debut for new connections after 61 days off - any market support would be significant given his poor recent form
Bizou attempts to follow up two recent wins but faces her first real test on turf after winning on synthetic - watch her early positioning

races.name: Fitzdares Apprentice Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands B-D)

runners_data.name: Poddle Park
runners_data.note: Unknown running style creates tactical uncertainty but Bell's 33,000gns purchase suggests ability with strong pedigree backing.
runners_data.spotlight: 33,000gns yearling; seventh foal; half-sister to four winners including Valpolicella (6f; RPR 83), Grand Cru Gaga (6f; 74) and Adelabella (1m; 71); dam unraced half-sister to Listed-placed 6f winner Chocoya; faces no easy starter.

runners_data.name: Matilda Joslyngage
runners_data.note: Hold-up filly with solid Irish maiden form who has been kept away from soft ground previously, suggesting going concerns despite OK rating.
runners_data.comment: Bit to prove on this slower ground but her form claims are right up there
runners_data.spotlight: Competitive in her last two maidens in Ireland, over 1m on good to yielding and good ground; taken out of two other races due to soft and yielding conditions, which is a bit of a concern; however, her form claims are right up there.

runners_data.name: Miss Guinevere
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced daughter of Camelot who faded badly on debut and sports a hood for this return after 72-day break.
runners_data.comment: Made a quiet start when ninth at Kempton (1m; 20-1) and she was weak in the market
runners_data.spotlight: Daughter of Camelot who cost 65,000euros as a yearling; made a quiet start when ninth at Kempton (1m; 20-1) and she was weak in the market; the hood fitted there is removed.

runners_data.name: Afraj
runners_data.note: Hold-up winner from November who showed inexperience but market support when scoring narrowly, returns after 191-day layoff.
runners_data.comment: Penalised for winning a weak 7f maiden at Chelmsford but her inexperience was evident
runners_data.spotlight: Penalised for winning a weak 7f maiden at Chelmsford in November but she defied market weakness with a narrow verdict and her inexperience was evident; certainly open to further improvement.

runners_data.name: Venetian Gold
runners_data.note: Hold-up filly who learned plenty from debut before winning well at Kempton, represents powerful Varian stable with recent winner.
runners_data.comment: She was more with it when running out a length winner at Kempton last month
runners_data.spotlight: 62,000gns breeze-up buy by St Mark's Basilica; did a lot wrong on her debut and was more with it when running out a length winner at Kempton last month; has to go well in this company even with her extra weight.

runners_data.name: Living In Hope
runners_data.note: Consistent trailer in both AW starts with modest form figures suggesting she belongs in handicap company.
runners_data.comment: Has brought up the rear in both her 1m races on the AW and looks one for handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Has brought up the rear in both her 1m races on the AW and looks one for handicaps.

runners_data.name: Blue Birdie
runners_data.note: Another hold-up runner who has been well beaten in longer trips, fades in finish and represents 9-day turnaround.
runners_data.comment: Tailed off in two visits to Kempton for 1m3f novice races
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off in two visits to Kempton for 1m3f novice races.

races.paceDynamic: With no confirmed front runner in this seven-horse field, the early pace will likely be pedestrian as the predominantly hold-up runners settle into their preferred positions. Poddle Park's unknown style creates uncertainty, but the lack of natural pace-setters means the field will drift along before quickening late. The moderate early tempo will set up a sprint finish over the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favours horses with finishing kicks and tactical speed - the hold-up merchants will have every chance to strike late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Slow Burn Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves genuinely sedate with runners tightly bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the closers to get into perfect position before unleashing their kicks in the final furlong. Hold-up horses like Venetian Gold and Afraj can time their challenges to perfection when the real racing begins late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Poddle Park Forces Pace
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced Poddle Park shows early speed and dictates terms from the front
scenarios.body: Cameron sends the unknown quantity forward to avoid traffic, creating a more genuine test that could catch out the hold-up horses. The sustained pace plays into the hands of horses that can travel strongly throughout rather than relying purely on late kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys are overly cautious and nobody wants to make the running until very late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a crawling tactical battle with runners still in a line turning for home before exploding into a frantic dash. The horse with the best turn of foot from the back of the field gains a decisive advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Injection of Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Matilda Joslyngage or another runner kicks on strongly approaching the turn
scenarios.body: Someone decides to inject pace at the three-furlong pole, stringing out the field and creating a more searching test. This tactical move could catch the pure hold-up horses flat-footed and favour those with more versatile running styles.

watchPoints.text: Poddle Park's unknown running style could completely alter the pace scenario if Cameron sends the lightly-raced filly forward early.
Matilda Joslyngage has been specifically avoided on soft ground previously, raising questions about her going preference despite the OK rating.
Miss Guinevere showed significant market weakness on debut and the 72-day gap plus hood addition suggests ongoing issues.
Venetian Gold's recent Kempton success came on the all-weather, so her turf debut on softer ground needs monitoring for any adjustment period.
The combined 191-day layoff for Afraj and general lack of recent race experience across several runners could lead to ring-rustiness affecting the finish.

races.name: Tommie Jakes Memorial Apprentice Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: Twirler
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning from 29-day break with strong recent Windsor win, suits the expected strong early pace
runners_data.comment: Did well to overcome trouble in running at Windsor a month ago; won on good to soft
runners_data.spotlight: Exposed six-time winner who did well to overcome trouble in running at Windsor one month ago (6f, good to firm; 4lb lower); unraced here but she's an Epsom winner on good to soft.

runners_data.name: Thunderous Love
runners_data.note: Prominent runner drawn low who may lead, back on last winning mark but low draw could be tactical disadvantage
runners_data.comment: Back on her last winning mark and perhaps stretched by 7f last time; ground fine
runners_data.spotlight: Back on her last winning mark and perhaps stretched by 7f last time when behind Land Of Magic; fine on all surfaces and considered, despite a low draw.

runners_data.name: Insuspense
runners_data.note: Hold-up type perfectly positioned for strong pace scenario, though ground conditions remain questionable
runners_data.comment: She's a consistent maiden but whether she wants slowish ground is questionable
runners_data.spotlight: Forced to challenge widest of all last time at Windsor so forget that; she's a consistent maiden but whether she wants slowish ground is questionable (withdrawn the once on account of such conditions).

runners_data.name: Moostar
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner with good form at the trip, trainer James Owen in decent form recently
runners_data.comment: Has been running well in defeat, though her form in cheekpieces is poor
runners_data.spotlight: Nursery winner over 6f on good to soft; more consistent than progressive in her recent defeats and mark continues to edge upwards; should still run well, provided the return of cheekpieces (replacing visor) doesn't trouble her as they've done nothing in the past.

runners_data.name: Addarella
runners_data.note: Prominent style but 37 days since last run may leave her needing the outing back on turf
runners_data.comment: Good first run for this yard back at Wolverhampton but hasn't kicked on at all
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins over this trip but on the AW and for Marco Botti; it was a good first run for this yard back at Wolverhampton but hasn't kicked on at all; ground conditions are another likely negative, together with stall 1.

runners_data.name: Land Of Magic
runners_data.note: Front-runner coming off good Lingfield second, dropping back to 6f should suit her tactical speed
runners_data.comment: Strike-rate of 4-35; best run for a while when a front-running second at Lingfield
runners_data.spotlight: Strike-rate of 4-35; best run for a while when a front-running second at Lingfield (7f, good) and dropping back to 6f won't hinder, nor the slower ground; could have done with a higher draw ideally but should run well.

runners_data.name: Rye
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent maiden drawn high in 10, but limited experience of ground slower than good
runners_data.comment: Consistent and well drawn but might not be helped by good to soft ground
runners_data.spotlight: Longstanding maiden but hard to knock her consistency and she's handily drawn in ten; however, only once has she encountered ground slower than good and she trailed home last.

runners_data.name: Midnight Call
runners_data.note: AW specialist making turf return, front-running style may struggle against stronger pace-setters here
runners_data.comment: Dictated from the front last time to make it 6-14 on the AW; unraced on slow turf
runners_data.spotlight: Has won two of her last three on the AW, taking overall record on synthetics to 6-14; last time she dictated from the front at Wolverhampton (4lb lower); seemed to handle turf fine in three previous attempts, though not on ground this slow.

runners_data.name: Magna
runners_data.note: Another AW winner for Tony Carroll making turf debut, no previous form on grass surfaces
runners_data.comment: Improver on the AW but she has no worthwhile form on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Has been on a roll on the AW and wasn't far away behind Midnight Call in her bid for a four-timer (fine at 5f and 6f); the glaring concern is that she has no worthwhile form on turf, albeit after just four attempts.

runners_data.name: Cameley Days
runners_data.note: Versatile runner stepping up in grade after recent 5f success, has proven turf form
runners_data.comment: In-form filly and latest defeat no backward step; has won over 6f on good to soft
runners_data.spotlight: Has won three of her last six races and the defeat at Lingfield 17 days ago was no backward step (5f, good); has another career high mark to deal with (raised 3lb) but she's a 6f winner on good to soft and very much considered from stall 8.

races.paceDynamic: Thunderous Love will likely lead from her low draw with Moostar, Land Of Magic, Midnight Call, Magna, Rye, Addarella and Cameley Days all showing prominent tendencies creating a potentially strong pace. With seven horses showing prominent/pace-setting inclinations, the early gallop should be honest rather than crawling, particularly as several have front-running form. Only Twirler and Insuspense are confirmed hold-up horses, meaning they'll need the pace to develop properly. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can finish from off the pace, as the abundance of early speed should create the perfect setup for late closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses benefit
scenarios.trigger: If the seven prominent runners create genuine early pace as expected
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop will set up perfectly for Twirler and Insuspense to unleash their finishing kicks. Both hold-up horses should get the race run to suit with plenty to aim at in the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace collapses early
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners get into a staring match and crawl early on
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace will make it a sprint from the 2f pole favouring those with natural speed. Thunderous Love and the Carroll horses Midnight Call/Magna could capitalize on their tactical speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained drive prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one prominent runner gets loose and dictates throughout
scenarios.body: A horse like Land Of Magic or Moostar could steal a march if they avoid the early scrimmaging. Their stamina and consistency at the trip would tell over the final furlong against tiring pace-setters.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Draw advantage decisive
scenarios.trigger: If the low-drawn runners get first run and maintain their position advantage
scenarios.body: Thunderous Love and Rye drawn in stalls 1 and 10 respectively could use their inside berths effectively. The tactical advantage of racing room could prove crucial in a competitive handicap.

watchPoints.text: Thunderous Love could get loose on the lead if the other prominent runners fail to press early
Watch Twirler and Insuspense for market support as the two genuine hold-up horses with the race setup to suit
Monitor how aggressively the seven prominent runners engage in the opening two furlongs
Tony Carroll's trio of Rye, Midnight Call and Magna switching from AW to turf - their adaptation crucial
Keep an eye on Insuspense's ground handling given her previous form suggests good ground preference

races.name: Join Fitzdares For A Personal Betting Service Apprentice Handicap

runners_data.name: Perfect Location
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with strong recent form including a runner-up effort off this mark on good to soft going
runners_data.comment: Can win races off this mark but didn't convince when upped to 7f last time
runners_data.spotlight: 6f maiden winner on the AW and runner-up off this mark on her handicap debut next time (6f, good to soft); again runner-up at Kempton two runs ago but over 6f and didn't convince when upped to 7f latest.

runners_data.name: Miss Lady Grace
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner who won over 7f from the lead but has struggled in handicaps since that maiden success
runners_data.spotlight: Her fifth start when winning a 7f maiden from the front at Wolverhampton in February; out the back in 6f/7f handicaps since then.

runners_data.name: Ahead Of Fashion
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose recent second came in a weak field and needs to prove the form has substance
runners_data.comment: Only four ran when second at Wolverhampton last time (7f) and that form is unconvincing
runners_data.spotlight: Placed a few times, though only four ran when second at Wolverhampton last time (7f) and that form is unconvincing; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Twilight Glow
runners_data.note: Hold-up type whose best form came on good to soft ground but has been gelded and is still finding his way
runners_data.comment: Best run was on good to soft; this is easier than a Class 4 at Ascot last time
runners_data.spotlight: His second on good to soft at Newbury last season (6f maiden) remains his best piece of form; gelded prior to this campaign and ran okay on his return (7f handicap) before struggling in a Class 4 over 6f at Ascot; one to consider in these calmer waters.

runners_data.name: Feisty Minx
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse stepping back down in trip after 1m looked too far, beaten just over a length on handicap debut
runners_data.comment: Close up over 7f on handicap debut and 1m seemed too far last time; first run on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten just over a length into fourth of seven on handicap debut at Kempton (7f) and 1m seemed too far back there 16 days ago; not yet exposed, though this is her first time on the grass.

runners_data.name: Chelio
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who showed promise last season but has been well held in two handicaps this campaign
runners_data.comment: Short in the betting for both handicaps and Windsor last time didn't go to plan
runners_data.spotlight: Promising runs last season at 7f/1m; well held in two handicaps (7f/6f) this campaign, though was quite short in the betting for both and Windsor last time didn't go to plan; wouldn't rule out.

runners_data.name: Ice Cube
runners_data.note: Front-runner who has shown plenty of early pace over 1m before weakening, dropping back in trip should help significantly
runners_data.comment: Has shown plenty of pace in 1m handicaps and dropping back to 7f should help
runners_data.spotlight: Only 5-4 and 4-1 for his two 1m handicaps since being gelded and showed plenty of pace both times before weakening; dropping back in trip should be a big help.

runners_data.name: Fanjove
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse and dual 7f winner on AW who can threaten off this mark despite disappointing last run
runners_data.comment: The winner of two 7f handicaps on the AW and has shown he can threaten off this mark
runners_data.spotlight: The winner of two 7f handicaps on the AW and has shown he can threaten off this mark; last run was disappointing but could bounce back, and no doubt a better horse now than when last seen on turf.

runners_data.name: Irish Fusilier
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning after 220 days off, step up in trip should suit his progressing profile
runners_data.comment: Made some progress in each of his runs last season (5f/6f); handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Made some progress in each of his runs last season (5f/6f) and was always likely to be seen to better effect once entering handicaps; this step up in trip should be a further plus; the market could be revealing after a lengthy break.

races.paceDynamic: Miss Lady Grace and Ice Cube will contest the early lead, with both having confirmed front-running styles and the pace likely to be genuine from the start. Miss Lady Grace has shown she can win from the front over 7f, while Ice Cube has displayed plenty of early pace in recent starts before weakening over longer trips. With two willing pace-setters and no obvious pace angles from mid-division, this should set up as an honest gallop throughout. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and hold-up horses who can benefit from the strong early pace and time their challenge late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If both Miss Lady Grace and Ice Cube commit to the lead and maintain a strong gallop
scenarios.body: The genuine pace will set up perfectly for hold-up horses to close late. Fanjove, Twilight Glow and Irish Fusilier can all benefit from this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Lady Grace can steal a march on Ice Cube and control the pace
scenarios.body: She can dictate terms from the front and use her 7f winning experience to see off late challengers. Her proven ability at the trip gives her a clear edge if she gets first run.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Perfect Location can sit just behind the pace-setters and avoid traffic
scenarios.body: She can use her strong recent form to strike at the right moment when the leaders weaken. Her runner-up efforts show she has the class to capitalise on a perfect tactical position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both Miss Lady Grace and Ice Cube go too fast too early and tie up
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any horse can win from any position. This chaotic scenario opens up the race for outsiders with tactical speed.

watchPoints.text: Ice Cube's early position is crucial - if he settles off the pace instead of leading, the race dynamics change completely
Perfect Location needs a clear run from her prominent position as apprentice jockey Harry Vigors may struggle in traffic
Miss Lady Grace's jumping from the stalls will determine if she can get first run on Ice Cube in the early pace battle
Irish Fusilier is having his first run in 220 days and needs to show he has trained on during his lengthy absence
Fanjove's early position will indicate connections' confidence - he needs to be closer than usual if bouncing back

races.name: Thelma Horne Memorial Apprentice Handicap

runners_data.name: Jakarta
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits the likely pace shape but withdrawn before on fast ground suggests some going sensitivity despite form figures.
runners_data.comment: Dual winner who enjoys cut underfoot; fast ground wasn't for her four days ago
runners_data.spotlight: Won on good and soft ground as a 2yo; nearly added a Newmarket 1m handicap during a light second season and fast ground (for which she's been withdrawn before) was perhaps not ideal when down the field 13 days ago; better expected.

runners_data.name: Asteverdi
runners_data.note: All three career wins came on soft ground or slower, making the conditions ideal for this hold-up performer.
runners_data.comment: Signs have been a tad more encouraging for James Owen and she's on a dangerous mark
runners_data.spotlight: All three wins for Alice Haynes were on ground slower than good; had lost her way but the signs have been a tad more encouraging for James Owen and she's on a dangerous mark.

runners_data.name: City Of God
runners_data.note: Natural leader who should get uncontested fractions but has been well beaten in two handicaps since joining current yard.
runners_data.comment: Won a seller in February; nearer last than first in two 1m handicaps for current yard
runners_data.spotlight: Left Karl Burke after winning an AW seller in February (1m); nearer last than first in two 1m handicaps for current yard.

runners_data.name: Silca Bay
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse trying turf in these conditions for first time but cheekpieces back on after keeping on well last start.
runners_data.comment: Usual cheekpieces are back on after keeping on well for fourth at Salisbury
runners_data.spotlight: All three wins on the AW and ground this slow will be a first for him; however, his usual cheekpieces are back on after keeping on well for fourth at Salisbury (1m, good) and he enters the equation.

runners_data.name: Cristo
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with both wins at Chelmsford over 1m2f, though showed good form when close second at Salisbury last time.
runners_data.comment: Runner-up on good ground at Salisbury and he's fine on soft; fairly solid claims
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins have been at Chelmsford over 1m2f; capable of winning on turf and had Silca Bay behind when going close at Salisbury last time (1m, good; effective on soft); more solid than most in here.

runners_data.name: Rising Force
runners_data.note: Two wins from five starts for current connections but slow start last time may have cost him and could be high in weights now.
runners_data.comment: Slow start was no help last time at Thirsk but he might be high in the weights now
runners_data.spotlight: He's 2-5 for this yard, the wins over 1m on good to soft and good to firm; a slow start was no help last time at Thirsk but he might be high in the weights now.

runners_data.name: Ararat
runners_data.note: Front-running sprinter trying a mile for the first time which looks a significant step into the unknown.
runners_data.comment: A five-time winner but over shorter distances; serious stamina concerns over this far
runners_data.spotlight: A five-time winner but over shorter distances and the fact he often front-runs could count against him now trying 1m for the first time; well beaten over 6f on recent stable debut.

runners_data.name: Port Erin
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with three 1m handicap wins last year but has been out of form since returning this season.
runners_data.comment: Capable of going well but the clear negative is complete no-shows in his last three starts

races.paceDynamic: City Of God will lead from the gates with Ararat and Port Erin providing prominent support in the early stages. The confirmed front-runner City Of God should get an uncontested lead given the lack of other natural pace-setters, allowing him to dictate fractions that suit his style. With most runners preferring to be held up (Jakarta, Asteverdi, Silca Bay, Cristo, Rising Force, Canopus), there will be limited early pressure on the leaders. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours the hold-up horses who can finish from off the pace, particularly those with proven tactical speed over this trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If City Of God gets soft fractions and stays the mile strongly
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows him to kick clear in the straight while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from too far back. His recent seller win proves he has winning form, even if modest class.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Speed Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly sedate and tactical speed decides it
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks, with Cristo and Jakarta best positioned given their class and recent form. Rising Force's two wins for this yard also make him dangerous in this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If Port Erin or Ararat track the leader perfectly and outstay him
scenarios.body: The prominent runners avoid the early pace battle but stay close enough to strike, with Port Erin's three 1m wins last year making him the most likely beneficiary. Ararat's step up to a mile for the first time looks a significant negative.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If City Of God stops quickly and the pace becomes a crawl throughout
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any horse with a turn of foot can win, making the ratings less reliable. Silca Bay's cheekpieces return could spark improvement while Canopus gets his lowest weight.

watchPoints.text: Watch if City Of God gets loose on the lead early - his recent form suggests he may not sustain a strong gallop
Watch Ararat's ability to settle over this new trip as his front-running style at sprint distances may not translate
Watch for any market support for Asteverdi given her preference for slower ground and trainer James Owen's recent form
Watch Rising Force's start given his slow beginning cost him last time at Thirsk over this distance
Watch late in the market for any confidence behind Silca Bay returning to turf with cheekpieces refitted

races.paceDynamic: Sixpack is the only confirmed front-runner and should get an uncontested lead with Dancing Tiger, Renesmee and Must Believe settling prominently behind. The pace will be sustainable rather than fierce, allowing the field to stay in touch through steady fractions. This sets up a proper staying test over the final three furlongs where stamina becomes paramount. The lack of pace pressure clearly favours hold-up horses who can use their finishing kick, with prominent racers also well-placed to strike if they stay the trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is sedate as expected with Sixpack uncontested
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows closers to get into perfect position and unleash their finishing speed when it matters most. Salamanca City and Tiger benefit from the tactical setup despite stamina questions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent stamina wins
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses Dancing Tiger and Must Believe can stay the extended trip
scenarios.body: Dancing Tiger's soft ground form and Must Believe's recent AW win suggest they have the stamina to capitalize on their forward positions. The moderate pace allows them to control their effort and kick when ready.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-runner stays strong
scenarios.trigger: If Sixpack's proven 1m6f stamina allows him to resist all challengers
scenarios.body: His recent Doncaster win over this trip gives him confidence, and the uncontested lead means he can dictate terms throughout. The 3lb rise may not stop a horse suited by the tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider emerges late
scenarios.trigger: If Love Is Golden's class from his hurdles wins translates back to the flat
scenarios.body: The 1329-day absence is a massive concern but the lack of early pace could allow him to gradually work his way into contention. Arthur's Realm could also benefit from the new trainer switch with these tactical conditions.

watchPoints.text: Sixpack could steal this if his uncontested lead combines with proven staying power to resist all challengers
Dancing Tiger's early positioning will be crucial as he tries to prove stamina matches his soft ground ability
Salamanca City's hold-up style suits the pace but watch for signs of stopping in the final furlong at this trip
Must Believe needs to settle better than usual to conserve energy for what would be his longest winning distance
Arthur's Realm requires significant improvement under new trainer Gihan Arnolda after disappointing 2025 form
